merchant.operations.entryHint.en: View details or prepare a local draft
merchant.operations.entryHint.zh-Hans: 查看详情或准备本地草稿

merchant.operations.syntheticArtwork.zh-Hans: 示例占位，不读取远程图片

merchant.operations.discardBody.en: These changes have not been sent to your store.
merchant.operations.discardBody.zh-Hans: 这些修改尚未发送到门店。

merchant.operations.exampleBoundary.en: Synthetic offline examples. Edits never change a real store, review decision, order, or provider resource.
merchant.operations.exampleBoundary.zh-Hans: 离线示例数据。编辑不会改变真实门店、审核结果、订单或供应商资源。

merchant.operations.liveDisabled.en: Live saving is unavailable. These forms only prepare local drafts.
merchant.operations.liveDisabled.zh-Hans: 真实保存尚未开放，这些表单仅用于准备本地草稿。

merchant.operations.loadFailed.en: Could not load these records. Try again.
merchant.operations.loadFailed.zh-Hans: 暂时无法读取这些记录，请重试。

merchant.operations.signedOut.en: Sign in again to view store records.
merchant.operations.signedOut.zh-Hans: 请重新登录后查看门店记录。

merchant.operations.invalidDraft.en: Review the draft fields before continuing.

merchant.operations.exampleSaved.en: Offline example saved. No real business change was made.
merchant.operations.exampleSaved.zh-Hans: 离线示例已保存，未产生真实业务变更。

merchant.operations.localDraftOnly.en: Your edits stay in memory and are not submitted or persisted.
merchant.operations.localDraftOnly.zh-Hans: 修改仅保留在内存中，不会提交或持久保存。

merchant.operations.unknownOutcome.en: The example outcome is unknown. Saving is locked; reading again does not prove that the earlier operation failed.
merchant.operations.unknownOutcome.zh-Hans: 示例结果未确认，保存已锁定；再次读取不能证明之前的操作失败。

merchant.operations.conflict.en: The source changed while you were reviewing. Reload before preparing another draft.
merchant.operations.conflict.zh-Hans: 检查草稿期间来源已变更，请重新读取后再编辑。

merchant.operations.confirmExampleBody.en: Save this frozen draft only to the offline example for this session?
merchant.operations.confirmExampleBody.zh-Hans: 是否仅将这份草稿保存到本次会话的离线示例？

merchant.operations.reviewNoApproval.en: A saved draft does not mean content approval, public visibility, or activation.
merchant.operations.reviewNoApproval.zh-Hans: 草稿保存不代表内容审核通过、公开可见或业务生效。

merchant.operations.profileWhitelist.en: This editor includes name, introduction, merchandise, derivative benefits, website, preferences and the existing logo. Contact and eligibility fields are not edited here.
merchant.operations.profileWhitelist.zh-Hans: 此编辑器包含名称、简介、衍生品、衍生权益、网站、偏好及原有标志；不编辑联系资料或商家资格。

merchant.operations.decorPreserved.en: Category, featured content, service details and location fields remain as read. Their selectors need separate verified contracts.
merchant.operations.decorPreserved.zh-Hans: 行业、精选内容、服务信息及位置字段按读取值保留；相关选择器需要独立验证的契约。

merchant.operations.tagsHint.en: Separate tags with semicolons. The request preview uses a JSON array string.
merchant.operations.tagsHint.zh-Hans: 以分号分隔标签，请求预览使用 JSON 数组字符串。

merchant.operations.galleryHint.en: Up to 9 images. Removing an item only edits this local draft.
merchant.operations.galleryHint.zh-Hans: 最多 9 张图片，移除操作只修改本地草稿。

merchant.operations.uploadDisabled.en: Image selection, permissions and real uploads are not enabled. Existing references are preserved.
merchant.operations.uploadDisabled.zh-Hans: 尚未开放图片选择、权限申请和真实上传，原有图片引用会保留。

merchant.operations.storyHint.en: Story body only, up to 300 UTF-16 units. The existing hidden title is preserved; the source save uses two separate operations.
merchant.operations.storyHint.zh-Hans: 仅编辑故事正文，最多 300 个 UTF-16 单元。保留原有隐藏标题，来源保存涉及两个独立操作。

merchant.operations.coopPreserved.en: Activity types and cooperation availability are hidden source fields and will be preserved.
merchant.operations.coopPreserved.zh-Hans: 适合活动类型与合作开放状态为隐藏来源字段，会原样保留。

merchant.operations.characterReviewHint.en: This is the private store character. Its review state is independent from public visibility, voice and 3D generation.
merchant.operations.characterReviewHint.zh-Hans: 这是门店私有形象配置，其审核状态与公开展示、声音及 3D 生成分别独立。

merchant.operations.templateOwnerOnly.en: Private template answers are read from the owner-only detail endpoint.
merchant.operations.templateOwnerOnly.zh-Hans: 模板答案仅从所有者专用详情接口读取。

merchant.operations.templateOmissions.en: Blank optional fields are omitted by the source contract; blanking one does not request deletion of its saved value.
merchant.operations.templateOmissions.zh-Hans: 来源契约会省略空的可选字段；清空输入不代表删除已存值。

merchant.operations.templatePageLimit.en: The source reads page 1 with up to 100 templates. This is not a complete or paginated inventory.
merchant.operations.templatePageLimit.zh-Hans: 来源读取第 1 页，最多 100 个模板；这不是完整或可翻页的清单。

merchant.operations.cityReadOnly.en: Location claims, placement, withdrawal, online status changes and redemption are unavailable here.
merchant.operations.cityReadOnly.zh-Hans: 此处尚未开放据点认领、投放、撤回、上下架和核销操作。

merchant.operations.quotaExhausted.en: The reported location limit has been reached.
merchant.operations.quotaExhausted.zh-Hans: 服务端报告的据点配额已用完。

merchant.operations.resourcesBoundary.en: Source-reported resources only. No recording, cloning, generation, playback, download or automatic polling.
merchant.operations.resourcesBoundary.zh-Hans: 仅展示来源报告的资源状态，不录音、克隆、生成、播放、下载或自动轮询。

merchant.operations.voiceDisabled.en: Voice consent, microphone access, sample upload and revocation are not enabled.
merchant.operations.voiceDisabled.zh-Hans: 声音授权、麦克风权限、样本上传及撤销尚未开放。

merchant.operations.avatarDisabled.en: Image upload, 3D generation and model downloads are not enabled.
merchant.operations.avatarDisabled.zh-Hans: 图片上传、3D 生成及模型下载尚未开放。

merchant.operations.galleryLimit.zh-Hans: 相册最多保留 9 张图片。

merchant.operations.featuredIncomplete.en: Featured type and ID must be present together.
merchant.operations.featuredIncomplete.zh-Hans: 精选类型和编号必须同时存在。

merchant.operations.decorEmpty.en: Fill in at least one storefront field.
merchant.operations.decorEmpty.zh-Hans: 请至少填写一项店铺装修内容。

merchant.operations.capacityInvalid.en: Capacity must be a nonnegative whole number or blank.
merchant.operations.capacityInvalid.zh-Hans: 接待人数须为非负整数，也可以留空。

merchant.operations.chargeUnknown.en: Choose a supported hosting fee option.
merchant.operations.chargeUnknown.zh-Hans: 请选择受支持的承接收费方式。

merchant.operations.characterNameLimit.en: Character names must be within 20 UTF-16 units.
merchant.operations.characterNameLimit.zh-Hans: 形象名称不能超过 20 个 UTF-16 单元。

merchant.operations.characterAvatarRequi.en: An existing uploaded character avatar is required. Uploading is not enabled.
merchant.operations.characterAvatarRequi.zh-Hans: 需要已有的已上传形象头像，当前尚未开放上传。

merchant.operations.greetingLimit.en: Keep the greeting within 60 UTF-16 units.
merchant.operations.greetingLimit.zh-Hans: 招呼语不能超过 60 个 UTF-16 单元。

merchant.operations.personaRequired.en: Describe the character’s personality and speaking style.
merchant.operations.personaRequired.zh-Hans: 请填写形象的人设与说话风格。

merchant.operations.personaLimit.en: Keep the personality within 1,000 UTF-16 units.
merchant.operations.personaLimit.zh-Hans: 人设不能超过 1,000 个 UTF-16 单元。

merchant.operations.knowledgeLimit.en: Keep store knowledge within 2,000 UTF-16 units.
merchant.operations.knowledgeLimit.zh-Hans: 店铺知识不能超过 2,000 个 UTF-16 单元。

merchant.operations.storyLimit.en: Keep the story within 300 UTF-16 units.
merchant.operations.storyLimit.zh-Hans: 故事正文不能超过 300 个 UTF-16 单元。

merchant.operations.methodRequired.en: Choose how players complete this interaction.
merchant.operations.methodRequired.zh-Hans: 请选择玩家完成互动的方式。

merchant.operations.optionsRequired.en: Fill in at least two options.

merchant.operations.correctRequired.en: Point the correct answer to a filled A–D option.
merchant.operations.correctRequired.zh-Hans: 请将正确答案指向已填写的 A–D 选项。

merchant.operations.acknowledged.en: The server acknowledged the save. Review status still comes from the server.
merchant.operations.acknowledged.zh-Hans: 服务器已确认保存，审核状态仍以服务器为准。

merchant.operations.partialOutcome.en: Some writes were acknowledged, but the whole save could not be confirmed. Editing remains locked; do not resubmit.
merchant.operations.partialOutcome.zh-Hans: 部分写入已获确认，但无法确认整个保存流程。编辑将保持锁定，请勿重复提交。

merchant.operations.confirmLiveHint.en: Save these exact changes. Story title and story text are separate writes and can complete only partially.
merchant.operations.confirmLiveHint.zh-Hans: 保存这些更改。故事标题和正文分别提交，可能出现部分完成的情况。

merchant.operations.benefitsHint.en: Describe benefits such as a special drink, redemption discount or route stamp. Up to 100 UTF-16 units.
merchant.operations.benefitsHint.zh-Hans: 例如限定饮品、核销折扣或路线纪念章；最多 100 个 UTF-16 字符单位。

merchant.operations.benefitsLimit.en: Benefits must be no longer than 100 UTF-16 units.
merchant.operations.benefitsLimit.zh-Hans: 衍生权益不能超过 100 个 UTF-16 字符单位。

merchant.operations.profileReadback.en: The save was acknowledged. Showing the latest profile returned by the service.
merchant.operations.profileReadback.zh-Hans: 保存已收到确认，当前展示服务端重新读取的最新资料。

merchant.operations.profileReadbackFaile.en: The save was acknowledged, but the latest profile could not be read. Retry only reloads current data; it will not send the edit again.
merchant.operations.profileReadbackFaile.zh-Hans: 保存已收到确认，但暂时无法读取最新资料。重试只会重新读取，不会再次提交修改。
